description: Use when an agent must break a tie or split a test and cannot be seen to have chosen: one or more fair coins, each result and the tally of heads and tails, cryptographically random rather than Math.random. Do not use to pick among more than two options (/v1/random/pick) or to order a list (/v1/random/shuffle). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

count.description: How many coins to flip, 1-100. Defaults to 1.
